mechanism_narrative: The EGFR-FGFR1 novokine with a rigid_helix_20 linker (~30 Å) forces two structurally asymmetric RTKs into proximity (ECD ratio ~1.66:1, EGFR 621 aa vs FGFR1 374 aa). This enables transphosphorylation that synergistically activates the shared SHC1→GRB2:SOS1→RAS→MAPK and FRS2→GAB1→PI3K→AKT signaling axes while sterically excluding PLCG1/PLCG2 from the FGFR1 Y766 docking site due to the rigid geometry. The biased output (MAPK↑, AKT↑, PLCγ↓) promotes muscle structural gene expression (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11, TAGLN) and suppresses aged-marker immediate-early genes (EGR1, FOS, JUN, IL32, TXNIP) — a transcriptional program enriched in young skeletal muscle.
